O1.citation: Artifact says: “The run is invalid: seeing the case bar broke blindness. Discard its artifact and verdict entirely.” It also says: “Only the replacement run may count toward the pass rate.”

O2.citation: Artifact says: “Start a fresh, context-free runner... Provide only the case input and instruction... no bar...” and “Give a separate fresh judge only the new artifact, the case bar, and the skill’s first principles.”

O3.citation: Artifact says to inspect `git status`, compare paths with pre-run state, treat anything not provably runner-caused as unrelated user work, use “targeted, path-specific edits,” and stop if overlap cannot be separated confidently.

O4.citation: Artifact says: “Start a fresh, context-free runner in a throwaway sandbox whose only writable root is that directory” and “Sweep the live checkout again with `git status`...”

S1.citation: Smell absent: artifact says “Discard its artifact and verdict entirely” and “Only the replacement run may count toward the pass rate.”

rationale: The artifact invalidates the contaminated run, gives a defensible blind rerun and separate judging procedure, and uses targeted cleanup that preserves unrelated checkout work. It also keeps live-checkout inspection despite sandboxing.
